meta.videos_rule:
the title must name Dragon Quest XI/11 and one of the topic words, be 2 minutes to 2 hours long (drops Shorts and
full runs), and not be a cutscene, speedrun or numbered let's-play part; newest first, one video per channel, up to 5
candidates per topic. The candidates are then reviewed by hand in content/videos_review.json (keep or drop, with the
reason); the guide shows only kept videos. The upload date is shown next to every video.

party.name: The Luminary
party.intro: The Hero of , known as the Luminary within his story, is a young man from the sleepy village of Cobblestone. After participating in a coming-of-age ceremony, he finds out he is the reincarnation of an ancient Hero who once saved the world. On his 16th birthday, he sets out on his journey in order to fulfill his destiny.

src.t: List of skill types in Dragon Quest XI

Hero (Dragon Quest XI)

build.role: GamerGuides' character guide calls the Luminary a flexible fighter who takes part in many Pep Powers and can clear groups early with spells and greatsword skills.
build.weapon: Greatswords are suggested for the early game because their first skills cover both group fights and bosses, while swords catch up later and can pair with a shield or [[Dual Wielding]].

order.h: Take Flame Slash in Swords so the Itemized Kill Pep Power with Erik is available.
Take Helichopter in Greatswords for group fights.
If you want a stronger single-target hit early, also take Cutting Edge.
Head toward Unbridled Blade as the main boss skill; it needs one Swordmastery panel unlocked first.
Take Pep Up in Luminary so you can trigger Pep Mode on command for Pep Powers.
Work up Swordmastery toward Sword Dance, which can take over from Unbridled Blade against bosses.
Once Luminary expands, take Charm +40 for 10 free Skill Points.
Reset Luminary to get the spent SP back.
Take Gigaslash and Gigagash in the late game to hit all enemies.
Fill in the Strength passives, such as Strength +25, ahead of the other stat panels.

skip.h: Skip Metal Slash and Dragon Slash early; they only suit metal slimes and dragon-type foes.
If points are tight late, you can pass on Zap and Zapple in favour of the Charm +40 reset.
Skip the Magical Mending panel, since the Luminary has no group heal like Multiheal to benefit from it.

tips.h: Pep Up costs 25 MP; if you would rather not spend MP, the Pep-Up Power-Up panel is suggested in any case.
Blade of Ultimate Power costs 48 MP, so it drains the Luminary's MP quickly.
Fullheal and Omniheal are worth picking up in Luminary for emergencies.

build.role_h: GamerGuides' character guide calls the Luminary a flexible fighter who takes part in many Pep Powers and can clear groups early with spells and greatsword skills.
build.weapon_h: Greatswords are suggested for the early game because their first skills cover both group fights and bosses, while swords catch up later and can pair with a shield or Dual Wielding.

party.name: Erik
party.quote: A young man who has abandoned his lucrative life of crime to team up with the Luminary. He managed to sneak into Heliodor Castle and steal the Red Orb, but was eventually apprehended and thrown into the dungeons. After helping our Hero escape from his cell, he joined him on his travels...for not entirely selfless reasons.
party.intro: is a character in . He is a former Thief who becomes a companion to the early in the story after abandoning his life of crime.

src.t: List of skill types in Dragon Quest XI
Erik
Erik

build.role: GamerGuides' character guide calls him a fast damage dealer and thief who sets up big hits through status effects and later dual wielding.
build.weapon: Knives are suggested to start because they have strong skills for bosses, while boomerangs suit random battles but are weak against bosses.

order.h: Take Half-Inch first to steal and to enable the Itemized Kill Pep Power once the Luminary has Flame Slash.
Head toward Agility +30 in Guile for its hidden +10 SP.
Reset the tree to recover the points.
Take Sleeper Hit and Persecutter in Knives, since they work together.
Take Cobra Strike and Victimiser next; poison works on more later bosses than sleep.
Unlock Dual-Wielding in Knives as your short-term goal.
Unlock Divide in Guile next; it effectively triples Erik's damage for one turn.
Once the trees expand, take Critical Claim as a long-term staple despite its MP cost.
Take Dually Deadly in Swords to remove the offhand damage penalty, plus Double Down in Boomerangs.
Take Fatal Flash in Swords for stronger single-target and boss damage.

skip.h: Skip the early Swords skills; Flame Slash is the only one that is not situational.
Hold off on boomerangs early, as they lack boss-fighting skills.

tips.h: Use Divide with Half-Inch to triple the steal rate; Sticky Fingers raises it further after the trees expand.
Critical Claim costs 64 MP but always lands a critical hit, which helps when hunting metal slimes.
His key late skills are spread apart, so aim for an overall package until you can farm Seed of Skill items.

build.role_h: GamerGuides' character guide calls him a fast damage dealer and thief who sets up big hits through status effects and later dual wielding.
build.weapon_h: Knives are suggested to start because they have strong skills for bosses, while boomerangs suit random battles but are weak against bosses.

party.name: Veronica
party.quote: I never thought I'd finally meet you in a place like this! It's funny how things work out.
party.intro: A gifted young girl who wields powerful offensive spells. Fearless and a bit of a tomboy, she will stand up to anyone, be they an adult or even a fearsome monster.

src.t: List of skill types in Dragon Quest XI
Veronica (Dragon Quest XI)
Veronica (Dragon Quest XI)

build.role: GamerGuides' character guide calls her the main offensive spellcaster, with strong group damage and debuffs.
build.weapon: Heavy Wands are suggested because Veronica is a caster and wand hits restore some MP, while whips need Strength she lacks.

order.h: Head down the Vim tree toward Channel Anger, which needs four of the surrounding panels.
Take the panels on the right side on the way, avoiding Spooky Aura.
After Channel Anger, take the remaining resistance passive below it.
Move to Heavy Wands for its passives rather than its skills.
Once the trees fully unlock, head toward Maximum MP +30 in Vim for a free 10 SP.
Reset the Vim tree.
Rebuild it going right this time.
Head toward Enchanting Echo, which needs the two panels just under Antimagic.
Collect the remaining Vim spells, such as Kaboomle and Kafrizzle.
Finish the rest of the Heavy Wand passives.

skip.h: Skip the Whips tree; Sylvando is the better whip user and her spells already hit groups.
Skip Spooky Aura on the way to Channel Anger.
Do not aim for Antimagic early; it only helps against heavy spellcasting foes.

tips.h: Channel Anger is a better pick than Ring of Ruin, since Veronica is likely the only offensive caster.
Sage's Breath helps keep her MP up in later fights.
Zing Stick gives an extra way to revive a downed ally in emergencies.

build.role_h: GamerGuides' character guide calls her the main offensive spellcaster, with strong group damage and debuffs.
build.weapon_h: Heavy Wands are suggested because Veronica is a caster and wand hits restore some MP, while whips need Strength she lacks.

party.name: Serena
party.quote:
Bold Luminary, Yggdrasil's chosen, long have I waited to greet you.
We of Arboria swear to protect you. While we live none shall defeat you.
party.intro: Serena (セーニャ, Sēnya) is a character from Dragon Quest XI. She is a dependable healer, capable of using recovery and protective magic, as well as using her lyre in battle for various effects. Both her and her twin sister Veronica come from the land of Arboria and have sworn to protect and aid the Luminary on his journey.

src.t: List of skill types in Dragon Quest XI
Serena (Dragon Quest XI)
Serena (Dragon Quest XI)

build.role: GamerGuides' character guide calls her the main early healer and support buffer.
build.weapon: Wands are suggested because they allow a shield and boost Magical Mending; spears are only worth it briefly, mainly for early metal slime hunting.

order.h: If you want early spear use, take Thunder Thrust and Party Pooper in Spears.
Reset Serena once Jade joins and send her down the Wands tree.
Stack Magical Mending panels through the first portion of the game to power her heals.
Take Snap, Crackle, Poof in Wands, the suggested pick from her starting trees.
When her trees expand mid-game, take Channel Anger and Enchanting Echo.
Add some Magical Might.
Take Hypnowhip mid-game only to make one Holier Hymns panel reachable.
In the final portion, return to Magical Mending.
Take both Holier Hymns panels and all the Hymns.
Take all Wands passives and Divine Restitution.

skip.h: Skip the Heavy Wand tree when it opens mid-game; it offers little for her.
Skip Dual-Wielding in Wands; a single wand with a shield is suggested for defence.

tips.h: Her first group heal, Multiheal, arrives at level 35, so plan around single-target healing before then.
Once you rely on Omniheal, Magical Mending matters much less because it heals the party to full.
The Hymns in Harpistry become much stronger once you have the two Holier Hymns passives.

build.role_h: GamerGuides' character guide calls her the main early healer and support buffer.
build.weapon_h: Wands are suggested because they allow a shield and boost Magical Mending; spears are only worth it briefly, mainly for early metal slime hunting.

party.name: Sylvando
party.quote: This wandering wonder joined our Hero on his quest in order not just to help him, but to spread smiles and laughter across all of Erdrea. Indefatigably upbeat, and as noble as any knight, Sylvando is a performer par excellence who leaves a trail of adoring fans in his wake where ever he goes.
party.intro: Sylvando (シルビア, Shirubia) is a character from Dragon Quest XI. He is a traveling performer, known by the moniker "the Great Sylvando", who puts his flamboyant talents to use in combat with a variety of colorful techniques, and is capable of equipping whips, knives, and one-handed swords, the latter two he can dual-wield.

src.t: List of skill types in Dragon Quest XI
Sylvando
Sylvando

build.role: GamerGuides' character guide calls him an early party-wide healer and buffer who sets up allies, fading somewhat later in the game.
build.weapon: Knives are suggested after the core skills, since they lead to Have A Ball and the Chivalry tree and help set up Erik's poison and sleep combos.

order.h: Head through Litheness toward Hustle Dance as soon as he joins, taking Sobering Slap on the way.
If you want extra points, detour to Charm +40 in Showmanship for 10 free SP.
Reset that tree.
Continue with the next step.
Take Hustle Dance, likely your first party-wide heal.
Take Pink Pirouette and That's Amore near Hustle Dance.
Take the Knives tree, including Cobra Strike, to poison foes for Erik's Victimiser.
Unlock Have A Ball in Litheness through the Knives side.
If you choose whips instead, take Wyrm Whip and Lash Batter.
When Chivalry unlocks, take Ladies First and Finger of Justice.

skip.h: Swords add nothing exclusive for him; only use them if no one else needs swords.
If you take Whipping Boy, also take the other Whipping passives, since enemies may not target him.

tips.h: Raise his Charm to make Hustle Dance and That's Amore stronger.
Showmanship is reached through either Litheness or Whips.
Gold Rush costs 1,000 gold per use instead of MP and hits all enemies.

build.role_h: GamerGuides' character guide calls him an early party-wide healer and buffer who sets up allies, fading somewhat later in the game.
build.weapon_h: Knives are suggested after the core skills, since they lead to Have A Ball and the Chivalry tree and help set up Erik's poison and sleep combos.

party.name: Jade
party.quote: This Princess of Heliodor has been on the road ever since Dundrasil fell back in the day, when she fled with our infant Luminary in her arms. When she was reunited with him years later, she didn't hesitate in joining him on is quest to confront the foul fiend who took from her all that she held dear.
party.intro: Jade (マルティナ, Marutina) is a character in .

src.t: List of skill types in Dragon Quest XI

build.role: GamerGuides suggests her for nearly every party lineup and calls her a physical powerhouse.
build.weapon: Spears are suggested throughout because that tree holds her strongest single-target and critical-hit skills.

order.h: Take Strength panels for Jade.
Set Jade on the Spears tree when she joins.
Head toward Multithrust as her main attack.
Take Party Pooper as her only group attack until her other trees open.
Once her trees open, head toward Multifeet in Fisticuffs while still favouring Strength.
After Multifeet, work up Allure to Femme Fatale.
Take Pink Typhoon, which is required before the locked Pink Tornado.
Unlock Pink Tornado.
Start raising Jade's Charm for her Allure skills.

skip.h: Skip Claws; spears outclass them for her.
Stop using Pink Typhoon once you have Pink Tornado.

tips.h: Thunder Thrust and Lightning Thrust are useful for metal slime grinding.
Belle's Bow from Quest 18 at +3 restores 6 MP per round; two of them give 12 MP per round.

party.name: Rab
party.quote: The former monarch of the fallen realm of Dundrasil, and our Hero's grandfather. He fled on the fateful night his kingdom found itself overcome by monsters, and has wandered the world ever since with Princess Jade. It's a little known fact that he's actually the youngest of three brothers.
party.intro: Rab (ロウ, Rō), also know by his formal title of Lord Robert, is a character in Dragon Quest XI. Despite his advanced age, he displays considerable abilities as a martial artist and magical prowess. He is a former king of Dundrasil, and is the grandfather of the Luminary.

src.t: List of skill types in Dragon Quest XI
Rab
Rab

build.role: GamerGuides' character guide calls him a jack of all trades who buffs, debuffs, heals and deals some damage, handy in boss fights.
build.weapon: Heavy Wands are suggested early since Claws have little until that tree expands; later you choose Claws or a return to Heavy Wands.

order.h: Take Heavy Wands first, including Zing Stick for guaranteed revives.
Take Benediction in Enlightenment to cure Curse.
Leave the rest of that tree early.
Once his trees fully unlock, pick a path: Claws or Enlightenment.
If you go Claws, take Rake 'n' Break to strip enemy buffs.
If you go Claws, take Hardclaw and Wild Animaul, aiming for critical hit chance.
If you go Claws, collect all the Claws passives.
If you go Enlightenment, plan for many SP to reach Kacrackle and Kazammle.
At high levels, either stay on Claws or return to Heavy Wands to build Enlightenment.

skip.h: Skip Claws and most of Enlightenment early; there is little there besides Benediction.

tips.h: If you skip Claws, Clear Your Mind in Enlightenment also removes enemy buffs.
Use Wild Animaul when not chasing crits; otherwise Hardclaw keeps its crit chance across hits.

build.role_h: GamerGuides' character guide calls him a jack of all trades who buffs, debuffs, heals and deals some damage, handy in boss fights.

party.name: Hendrik
party.quote: Once the master and commander of the armies of Heliodor, Hendrik's unwavering loyalty was expertly exploited by the monstrous Mordegon. These days, he is the hero of the people of the Last Bastion thanks to his tireless efforts in securing their safety. His beard is his little homage to King Carnelian's fantastic facial hair.
party.intro: Hendrik (グレイグ, Gureigu) is a character from .

src.t: List of skill types in Dragon Quest XI
Hendrik
Hendrik

build.role: GamerGuides' character guide calls him a versatile tank and damage dealer, especially with axe and shield.
build.weapon: Axes are suggested because every axe skill is useful and they allow a shield; late on you can switch to greatswords for more damage.

order.h: Take the Axes tree when he joins, starting with Helm Splitter and Scrap Mettle.
Take Parallax for strong single-target damage.
Take Axes of Evil for group damage, using it sparingly due to his low MP.
Take Hatchet Man for metal slimes and high-defence foes.
When Fraternity unlocks, head straight for Forbearance if you use shields.
Take Steadfast Forbearance to reduce damage taken while drawing attacks.
Late in the final part, either stay on axe and shield or switch to greatswords for more damage.

skip.h: Skip the Swords tree; it has nothing exclusive and Dual Wielding suits him poorly.
Defending Champion lasts one turn and cannot combine with Forbearance.

tips.h: In the Definitive Edition, the 10SP bonus is on Magical Mending +20 in Fraternity, not H-Pathy.
Pair Holy Impregnable with a Catholicon Ring +3 for near-total ailment immunity.
Blind Man's Biff deals full damage regardless of Dazzle after Quest 48.

build.role_h: GamerGuides' character guide calls him a versatile tank and damage dealer, especially with axe and shield.
build.weapon_h: Axes are suggested because every axe skill is useful and they allow a shield; late on you can switch to greatswords for more damage.

chapters.title: Birth of a Luminary
chapters.goal_h: Climb Cobblestone Tor with Gemma, win your first fights and reach the summit to finish the coming-of-age ceremony.

chapters.title: Cobblestone
chapters.goal_h: Loot your home village, finish its first quest and leave for Heliodor with a map and a horse.

chapters.title: Heliodor Region
chapters.goal_h: Walk north from Cobblestone through the Heliodor Region to the city of Heliodor, looting both paths and the first camp.

level.t: Reach level 5 on the way to the camp; it teaches [[Heal]] and unlocks the Character Builder.
level.h: Reach level 5 on the way to the camp; it teaches Heal and unlocks the Character Builder.

chapters.title: Heliodor
chapters.goal_h: Loot Heliodor and its castle and finish both town quests before meeting the King, since that audience locks you out of town.

chapters.title: Heliodor Sewers
chapters.goal_h: Break out of the dungeon with your cellmate, slip through the sewers and flee the Black Dragon.

chapters.title: Return to Heliodor
chapters.goal_h: Recruit Erik, explore the Heliodorian Foothills, then use Downtown Heliodor to trace the Red Orb to The Kingsbarrow.

chapters.title: The Manglegrove
chapters.goal_h: Cross The Manglegrove, unlock the Fun-Size Forge, beat the Tricky Devil so the bridge is fixed, and reach Cobblestone.

chapters.title: Cobblestone and The Emerald Coast
chapters.goal_h: Witness Cobblestone's past and ruined present, dig up the Keystone at Cobblestone Falls, and prepare at the Emerald Coast camp.

chapters.title: The Kingsbarrow
chapters.goal_h: Take back the Red Orb from The Kingsbarrow by beating the Grim Gryphons, then escape through the Door of Departure.

chapters.title: Hotto and the Hotto Steppe
chapters.goal_h: Explore Hotto, meet Veronica, finish Hotto's two forging quests, and level up before The Cryptic Crypt.

level.t: Be at least level 10 on the Steppe and reach level 12 on [[Robber Rabbit]]s before The Cryptic Crypt.
level.h: Be at least level 10 on the Steppe and reach level 12 on Robber Rabbits before The Cryptic Crypt.

chapters.title: The Cryptic Crypt
chapters.goal_h: Find Serena, beat Jarvis to restore Veronica's magic, and leave Hotto with the twins and the Zoom spell.

chapters.title: The Sultanate of Gallopolis
chapters.goal_h: Win the Sand National for Prince Faris, beat the Slayer of the Sands, and recruit Sylvando before heading to Gondolia.

level.t: Be around level 15 for the Slayer of the Sands.
level.h: Be around level 15 for the Slayer of the Sands.

chapters.title: Gondolia
chapters.goal_h: Cross Laguna di Gondolia, fetch the cure from Grotta della Fonte for the Doge's son, and beat Jasper to rescue Erik and gain a ship.

level.t: Be at least level 18 for Grotta della Fonte.
level.h: Be at least level 18 for Grotta della Fonte.

chapters.title: Search for the Rainbough
chapters.goal_h: Sail to Zwaardsrust and Octagonia, win the martial arts tournament with Vince, and beat Arachtagon under the orphanage.

level.t: Be around levels 18-20 in Zwaardsrust and at least level 22 before Arachtagon.
level.h: Be around levels 18-20 in Zwaardsrust and at least level 22 before Arachtagon.

chapters.title: To Dundrasil Castle Ruins
chapters.goal_h: Cross the Dundrasil Region to the castle ruins, follow Rab to the truth about your birth, and gain Rab, Jade and the Rainbough.

chapters.title: To Puerto Valor
chapters.goal_h: Clear The Costa Valor, cash in medals, quests and casino prizes in Puerto Valor, then open the sluice to the outer sea.

chapters.title: The Green Orb
chapters.goal_h: Find Kai for the mermaid Michelle, beat Tentacular, and receive the Green Orb from Queen Marina in Nautica.

level.t: Be around level 24 or higher before sailing to Lonalulu.
level.h: Be around level 24 or higher before sailing to Lonalulu.

chapters.title: The Silver Orb
chapters.goal_h: Explore The Champs Sauvage and the Academie, then climb The Eerie Eyrie and beat the Elysium Bird for the Silver Orb.

chapters.title: The Purple Orb
chapters.goal_h: Free Phnom Nonh from the cursed mural by beating Dora-in-Grey, take the Magic Key, and open the Zwaardsrust ruins door for the Purple Orb.

level.t: Be around level 29 entering The Other Side and level 30 for Dora-in-Grey.
level.h: Be around level 29 entering The Other Side and level 30 for Dora-in-Grey.

level.t: Fight Krystalinda at around level 31 or higher.
level.h: Fight Krystalinda at around level 31 or higher.

level.h: Be level 32 or higher for the upper Arborian Highlands.

level.h: The Luminary at level 33 or higher should handle the Heliodorian Foothills monsters.

level.t: Be around level 36 for the Champs Sauvage.
level.h: Be around level 36 for the Champs Sauvage.

chapters.title: Reuniting with Jade
chapters.goal_h: Free King Irwin in Dundrasil, then beat Jinxed Jade and Booga in Octagonia to win back Jade and Lorelei's Harp.

level.h: Be around level 42 to 43 by the Gyldenhal boss.

level.h: Be around level 44 before the Auroral Serpent.

chapters.title: Forging the Sword of Legend

chapters.title: The Fortress of Fear

level.h: Reach at least level 50 inside the fortress, and be around level 55 before the final battle.

level.h: Start this stage at level 57 or higher, and be around level 60-64 before the Heliodor quests and Bathysfear; levelling to 99 now trivializes the post-game.

level.h: Be level 65 or higher for Blind hatred and at least level 70 for the Citadel of Spite, where the monsters give a lot of experience.

howto.title: How to pick the game back up after a break

steps.h: Load your newest save.
Open the main menu.
Find your chapter in the Walkthrough tab of this guide by the last town or dungeon you remember.
Read the chapter's goal line and the party level target.
Open Misc > Character Builder.
Spend any unspent skill points (the Character Builder how-to shows how).
Open the Fun-Size Forge from the Important Items menu.
Check which recipe books you own.
If the walkthrough level target is above your party, farm with the Level up fast how-to before the next boss.
If you are past Calasmos in the third act, jump to the Post-game checklist tab.

howto.check: You know your chapter, your party has no unspent points, and you know the next level target.

howto.title: How to spend skill points in the Character Builder
howto.need: You'll need: skill points from levelling up or a [[Seed of Skill]].

steps.h: Open the main menu > Misc > Character Builder.
Pick the character; each block of panels is one weapon or skill type.
Unlock a panel next to one you already own; you can only unlock adjacent panels.
Plan a route toward the panels marked ?; each shows how many surrounding panels it needs before it opens.
Commit to one weapon type per character first; the Party tab lists every panel with its SP cost.
If you chose badly, go to any church or priest.
Pick Rectification there to reset one whole skill type (not single panels).
Pay the reset fee: 20 gold per skill point refunded. Rectification opens once Veronica and Serena have joined.

howto.check: The panel lights up and its skill appears in the character's Abilities list.
howto.why: Panels expand after major story events, and at level 99 the only new points come from a [[Seed of Skill]], worth one point each.

howto.title: How to forge a +3 item at the Fun-Size Forge
howto.need: You'll need: the recipe book, the materials (see the item card), and for reworking, [[Perfectionist's pearl]]s.

steps.h: Open the Fun-Size Forge from the Important Items menu (Definitive Edition lets you forge almost anywhere).
Choose either a new item to craft or rework to improve one you own.
Pick Bash on one square.
Watch its gauge fill.
Stop each gauge inside the green range; aim for the small notch, where the meter turns yellow.
Watch Focus in the bottom left: Bash costs 5 Focus, Flourishes cost more.
Use Flourishes to hit several squares at once; the first one unlocks at Level 10.
If the Master Stroke (Hephaestus' Flame, learned at level 55) appears, use it when a square is close to its notch.
Use Appraise: Pretty well means +1, Really well +2, Brilliantly +3.
Finish with every gauge green for a guaranteed +1.
For a +3 on a new item, get at least half the gauges yellow.
If you fail a rework, nothing is lost: the item keeps its previous bonus.

howto.check: The finished item shows its stat bonus as +1, +2 or +3.
howto.why: Each stat on an item card reads base/+1/+2/+3, so a +3 forge is often worth more than a shop upgrade.

howto.title: How to use Pep Powers
howto.need: You'll need: the right skill panels for combo Pep Powers (see the table on the source page).

steps.h: Fight normally or Guard until a character peps up; the portrait glows.
Watch for the glow to flash: the pepped up state is about to end.
Swap pepped characters out of battle to hold the state while others pep up.
Bring them back for a group Pep Power.
Use a Pep pip to pep up one character, or a Pep pop to pep up the whole active party.
Buy a Pep pip at the Octagonia Casino for 125,000 tokens, or for 10 Mini medals each after you hand in 110.
Buy a Pep pop in Cobblestone in the final part of the game for 200,000G each.

howto.check: The Pep Power appears in the Pep Powers menu of the pepped characters.
howto.why: There are 83 Pep Powers; using 25 unlocks the Peppy-Go-Lucky trophy.

howto.title: How to level up fast with metal slimes
howto.need: You'll need: the [[Luminary]] with [[Pep Up]] (Luminary panels), [[Erik]], [[Jade]], [[Sylvando]], [[Rab]], and a few [[Pep pip]]s.

steps.h: Start a battle against enemies that do not run away with Rab, Erik, Jade and Sylvando.
Guard with them until all four are pepped up, swapping members in and out as needed.
Bring in the Luminary.
Use Pep Up.
Finish the battle.
Save.
Give Sylvando a Pep pip.
Start a new battle with the Luminary, Erik, Jade and Sylvando.
Use the Haulellujah Pep Power.
Swap Erik out for Rab.
Have the Luminary use Pep Up and Sylvando use a Pep pip on Jade.
Use the Electro Light Pep Power; if it calls robots instead of metal slimes, reload your save.
On Rab's next turn use Dirge of Dundrasil to put the slimes to sleep.
Finish them with critical-hit skills, not normal attacks, which can wake them up so they flee.

howto.check: At level 70+ one such fight can give at least 500,000 EXP to everyone; a [[Metal king slime]] (Vicious) then always drops a [[Pep pip]].
howto.need_h: You'll need: the Luminary with Pep Up (Luminary panels), Erik, Jade, Sylvando, Rab, and a few Pep pips.

howto.title: How to farm stat seeds
howto.need: You'll need: drop-rate gear: two [[Bunny tail]]s per character, the [[Pirate king's pendant]] on [[Erik]].

steps.h: Equip the drop-rate gear; seeds are always a monster's rare drop.
Bring the source's ideal team: Erik, Jade, Veronica and Serena.
Swap Veronica out for the Luminary to use the Haulellujah Pep Power, which makes the last three foes killed drop their rare items.
For Seed of life, go south over the bridge from the Champs Sauvage (North) campsite at night.
Fight the Corpse corporals there (up to three per battle).
For Seed of magic: in daytime on the Path to Trial Isle, fight the flying Vicious Terrornodons.
For Seed of strength: fight Brownies on Insula Incognita (Malicious ones in the last part).
For Seed of defence: fight Mosstodons in the First Forest, south of the Arboria entrance.
For Seed of Sorcery: fight Hooper dupers (see the gold how-to).

howto.check: Seeds land in the bag after battle; use them from the Items menu.

howto.title: How to farm Bunny tails
howto.need: You'll need: early game access to the Heliodor Region; the [[Luminary]], [[Erik]] and [[Jade]] for Haulellujah.

steps.h: Go to the Heliodor Region campsite (first or second part of the game).
At night, attack sleeping groups of Bunicorns (three or four together).
Steal the common drop with Half-Inch so only the Bunny tail is left to drop.
Once Jade joins, pep up the Luminary, Erik and Jade.
Use Haulellujah to guarantee rare drops from the last three foes.

howto.title: How to collect and spend Mini Medals
howto.need: You'll need: a boat (both exchange points need one).

steps.h: Open every chest, pot and barrel; the Mini Medals tab lists all known spots.
Hand medals in at Puerto Valor for the first page of the Album de Medailles.
Hand the rest in at L'Academie de Notre Maitre des Medailles; the reward table is on the Mini Medals tab.
If you want more after the last reward, race in the Black Cup at Gallopolis (a Drustan Trials wish); every race pays one medal.
Or farm Umbras at night in the Disciple's Trial - The Cruel Crypt.
Steal the Umbras' medal with Erik.

howto.title: How to choose Draconian Quest options
howto.need: You'll need: a new game (options are only offered on the naming screen).

steps.h: Start a new game and, on the naming screen, press the button shown to open Draconian Quest.
Tick only the options you want; the Draconian tab lists all of them and which version has them.
If an option becomes too much, remove it at any church.
Know that a removed option cannot be turned back on without an older save or a new game.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (1) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: Once you reach Puerto Valor, you can find a casino that has its own hotel next to it. In the one room upstairs, there is a pot that you can break for this Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (1) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: While still in the hotel casino in Puerto Valor, simply stay at the hotel to be rewarded with a Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (1) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: Reward for completing Quest 10 An Even Lovelier Letter . While you gain access to this quest while in Gondolia, you cannot complete it until you reach Puerto Valor.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (1) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: This Mini Medal is found at The Strand, in a chest nestled next to the large boat there.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (1) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: Found on Insula Occidentalis, which is north of The Strand. Look behind the cabin on this island for a pot you can break, which contains the Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (1) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: Found on Insula Orientalis, which is the island in the northeastern corner of the world map. There are some ruins on this island, where you can find some pots, one of which will contain the Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (1) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: In Lonalulu, head to the tavern that is southeast of the item shop. There will be some barrels to the south of the tavern, one of which will contain a Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (1) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: Once you complete the story events in Lonalulu, you can freely explore Saikiki Beach. There is a cabin here and next to the cabin will be a chest that contains a Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (1) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: In Nautica, there is a chest that is located behind the church, on the ground level, that contains a Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (1) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: In the Champs Sauvage region, you will find a campsite in the southern portion of the area. Head west of that camp to find a chest that has the Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (1) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: Once you finally reach L'Academie de Notre Maitre des Medailles, there will be a well you can enter near the entrance on the main grounds. There is a barrel in the well you can break to find this Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (1) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: Inside L'Academie de Notre Maitre des Medailles, go to the dormitories on the second floor and in one of the rooms, you can search a cabinet to find a Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (1) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: Inside L'Academie de Notre Maitre des Medailles, go into the principal's office on the first floor and break the pots there to find this Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (1) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: You will be rewarded with three Mini Medals upon completing Quest 19 Making Things Right .

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (1) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: Located in a chest in the Eerie Eyrie. It is on a ledge that requires the Rotten Eggoskeleton mount, along the main stream that's past the initial caves.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (1) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: In Phnom Nonh, head to the house that is east of the armor shop. On the top floor, you can find a pot that has the Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (1) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: You will find this one in The Other Side dungeon. In the Cursed Cloisters section, the lower level, there will be a chest that has the Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (1) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: Behind the Magic Key door in Gallopolis, break the pots there to find this Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (1) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: Behind the Magic Key door in Gondolia, break the pot in that room for this Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (1) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: In the Dundrasil Region, there is a small tower that is locked and requires the Magic Key. Inside this little tower is a chest that contains three Mini Medals.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (1) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: Behind the Magic Key door in Lonalulu, break the barrels to find a Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (1) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: Behind the Magic Key door in L'Academie de Notre Maitre des Medailles, you will find some pots, one of which will contain a Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (1) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: This one is found on Insula Centralis, which is accessible once you get Lorelei's Harp from the events in Lonalulu. East of Insula Borealis is a light you can use to reach the little area with this island. Once on the island, check the one tree near the dock to find a slightly hidden chest with the Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (1) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: Inside the Sniflheim Region area, there is a small cabin at a dead end that has a chest with the Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (1) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: This one is on the Snaerfelt. It is in a chest on top of one of the archways that is north of the camp.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (1) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: After thawing out Sniflheim, go into the castle and in the basement. There will be a pot there that you can break for a Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (1) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: After thawing out Sniflheim, go to the inn and near it will be some stalls. Slightly hidden behind one of the stalls is a chest that has the Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (1) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: This one is located in the Viking Hideout that is accessible in the same area as Sniflheim (you have to sail there). Near the entrance, there should be some barrels you can break that has a Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (1) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: As you use the Eggoskeleton to jump up the cliffs in the western portion of the Arborian Highlands, you will come across a chest with the Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (1) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: Look on the side of the stairs at the entrance to Arboria to find a chest with this Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (1) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: This one is found in the eastern portion of the Arborian Highlands. At the first intersection, go north and there will be a chest with the Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (1) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: In the First Forest, you will need to use the altar at the top to proceed with the story. Underneath that altar is a chest with the Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (1) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: During the second portion of the game, you will be in Nautica and using a different means of exploring. North of the item shop will be a ledge you can get to, where you'll find a chest with the Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (2) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: Located in Last Bastion, there is a barrel in one of the northern houses that's ruined. Break this barrel to find the Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (2) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: In the Heliodor Sewers, you will come across two locked doors that are side-by-side. Through the door on the left, there will be a chest that contains a Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (2) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: In the Heliodor Dungeon - Lower Levels, you will come across some familiar cells. Inside one of the cells, there are some pots, so break them to find the Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (2) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: In The Manglegrove, you will climb down a vine to reach the Marshlands section of the dungeon. As soon as you get off the vine, look to your north to spy a chest, which holds this Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (2) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: Once you enter Mount Pang Lai, there is a dead end that has a lot of tall grass towards the northwest. In this little area, you can find a chest among the tall grass, which has the Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (2) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: On the middle level of Angri-La, enter the room to the north of the church and break the one pot in here for a Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (2) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: In the northern part of the Dundrasil Region, look for the sparkling Demonrider and defeat it to gain the mount. Take the upper of the two paths up here and find the climbable wall to reach a higher ledge. From there, look for another climbable wall, which will bring you to a lower ledge and the chest with the Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (2) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: During the middle portion of the game, head to Insula Algarum and go to the second section of the place to find a Dragon Rider you can use as a mount. Once you are flying, go to the southwest portion of the island and fly over a ridge. As soon as you do, look underneath you on some rocks for a chest, which will contain the Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (2) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: This Mini Medal is also on Insula Algarum, and will require the Dragon Rider mount. It is found on a small piece of land in the northern section of the island. You know you've found the place, as there are two chests on the little piece of land, one of which will have the Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (2) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: In the Sniflheim area, you have access to the Viking Hideout. North of there, during the middle portion of the game, you will be forced to go to Gyldenhal. Just south of the entrance to that place, on the upper cliff, will rest a chest with this Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (2) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: Found in The Battleground dungeon. It is located on B2 of the place. After falling through the hole in the ground on B1, head southward and you'll find the chest with the Mini Medal in the next room.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (2) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: You will receive five Mini Medals as a reward for completing Quest 31 A Right Riddle . You cannot complete this until you have access to Gallopolis in the middle portion of the game, due to needing a Fizzle Foil weapon (Gallopolis has them for sale).

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (2) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: Once you get to Hotto in the middle portion of the game, progress the story along until you get the Mountain Gate Key from the maid at the temple. When you do this, search the one wardrobe in that back room of the temple for the Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (2) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: In the Lower Area of the Caldera of Mt. Huji, there is a little piece of land sticking out in the middle of the map. There is a large rock here, so you will need to procure a Visor Kaiser mount first.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (2) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: The final Mini Medal in the middle portion of the game is found inside of the Fortress of Fear. On Level 3 of the dungeon, you will encounter an area with an electrified floor, requiring you to use a Visor Kaiser mount to get past it. In the southwestern room on this floor, you will find the Visor Kaisers, as well as a chest.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (2) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: This one is found in the same spot as Mini Medal #54, as it respawns when you are in the third part of the game. This one is found in the eastern portion of the Arborian Highlands. At the first intersection, go north and there will be a chest with the Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (3) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: This one is found in the same spot as Mini Medal #55, as it respawns when you are in the third part of the game. In the First Forest, you will need to use the altar at the top to proceed with the story. Underneath that altar is a chest with the Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (3) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: Once you get invited back to Heliodor Castle after the events at the beginning of the final part, go to the throne room for a quick scene. Upon gaining control again, go north one room, then east to wind up in the kitchen. Break the barrels in there to find the Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (3) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: You will need the Ultimate Key in order to get this one, which is gotten at Havens Above. Once you have it, head to Gondolia and go through the locked door to find a little area with some goodies. In one of the pots in this little section will be the Mini Medal.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (3) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: Once you have the Ultimate Key and access to Cetacea again in the final part, fly to Champs Sauvage Whale Way Station. There will be a little tower with a locked door, so open it to find a chest with three Mini Medals.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (3) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: You will receive 10 Mini Medals as a reward for completing Quest 53 Now You See Me… .

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (3) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: During the final part of the game, you can do a side story in Phnom Nonh, which requires you to defeat a boss in the Other Side dungeon. Once you complete this, return to Son in Phnom Nonh to receive 10 Mini Medals.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (3) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: You will receive five Mini Medals as a reward for completing Quest 56 Sweet Dreams .

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (3) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: In a chest in The Disciple's Trial - The Cruel Crypt . The chest is located to the northeast of the first large room you can find in the dungeon, with it yielding two Mini Medals.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (3) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: In a chest in The Disciple's Trial - The Eerie Valley . After lowering the vine in the first area, go down it and get a Vicious Dread Dragooner mount. Fly to a ledge to the east to find the chest, which has three Mini Medals.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (3) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: In a chest in The Sage's Trial - The Fierce Forest . When you see two portals near the beginning, take the southern one and head northwest from where you regain control to find the chest, with three Mini Medals.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (3) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: In a chest on Level 2 of The Luminary's Trial - Citadel of Spite . It's on the northern ledge in the room where you need the Dragooner mount.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (3) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: You actually get this from a Sparkly Spot on Level 1 of The Luminary's Trial - Citadel of Spite . It's in the northern room on the eastern side.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (3) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

spots.where: Once you rebuild Cobblestone in the final part of the game, go to Dunstan's house (north of church) to find a barrel you can break for the Mini Medal in the upstairs room.

src_l.t: Mini Medals Locations (3) / Mini Medals / Extras (GamerGuides)

tick.how: In The Battleground, you will eventually descend deep enough to get to Floor B8. On this floor, you can find a chest next to a wall. In fact, when you slide down the one vine to get to this floor, you will see said wall and will be on the wrong side of it. Right next to that chest (contains a Chronocrystal) will be a purple Tockle that grants you this pastword.

src_l.t: Damdara / Altar of Origins / Tickington (GamerGuides)

tick.how: Galenholm is the first Pastword you will receive, with it gotten from Ickle upon first accessing the Tickington town. It is possible to complete this area as soon as you gain access to Tickington, where you should be around level 12-13.

src_l.t: Galenholm / Altar of Origins / Tickington (GamerGuides)

tick.how: During the final part of the game, once you unlocked the flying upgrade, you will be told of some trials you can do to help prepare for the final battle. This is located through one of the doors in the underground part west of the Warrior's Rest Inn. You will have to go through an area before reaching Trial Isle. Once you reach that location, check the north end of the outside portion of Trial Isle to find the Tockle.

src_l.t: Tantegel Castle / Altar of Origins / Tickington (GamerGuides)

tick.how: When you finally make it to the Royal Library up near Sniflheim, you will be able to get this pastword. Upon going from the first floor to the second, you will find the yellow Tockle with it on the staircase.

src_l.t: Alltrades Abbey / Altar of Reverie / Tickington (GamerGuides)

tick.how: You will find the Tockle at Havens Above. Once you reach there, in the outside area, go to the eastern side and you will find a green Tockle on a bench there.

src_l.t: Pillar of Pegasus / Altar of Reverie / Tickington (GamerGuides)

tick.how: Once you have finally obtained the Ultimate Key from Havens Above in the final part of the game, you can open a bunch of locked doors across Erdrea. Travel to Puerto Valor and open the locked door there, where you will find this Tockle.

src_l.t: Weaver's Peak / Altar of Reverie / Tickington (GamerGuides)

tick.how: Once you finish up the story events in Hotto in the middle portion of the game, you can go receive the Crucible Key from the maid in Miko's temple. This will allow you to go through the one locked door in Mt. Huji, which is required in order to progress the story. As soon as you pass through that locked door, you should see a purple Tockle, so speak to it to get the pastword.

src_l.t: Baramos's Castle / Altar of Salvation / Tickington (GamerGuides)

tick.how: You will unlock this area upon complete Baramos's Castle and receiving your reward from the King of Portoga.

src_l.t: Baramos's Castle / Later On / Altar of Salvation / Tickington (GamerGuides)

tick.how: Once you reach The Warrior's Rest Inn in the Zwaardsrust region, go inside and you will see the green tockle right there on the bottom floor.

src_l.t: Erdrick's Future Home / Altar of Salvation / Tickington (GamerGuides)

tick.how: In the final part of the game, once you regain your flight, there is a new Whale Way Station just north of Yggdrasil, called First Forest Whale Way Station. There is a Sparkly Spot here with a Silkblossom and the Tockle will be right next to it, sitting on a fallen tree.

src_l.t: Hidden Valley / Altar of the Chosen / Tickington (GamerGuides)

tick.how: Once you reach Arboria in the main story, go into the town and down the stairs by the item shop. On the western side down there, you will find a blue Tockle that will give you the pastword.

src_l.t: Imperial Pantry of Parthenia / Altar of the Chosen / Tickington (GamerGuides)

tick.how: During the middle portion of the game, you will be in the Sniflheim region and have to visit a dungeon, called Glydenhal. Before you enter the place, though, look to the west of the entrance to spy a green Tockle, so speak to it to get the pastword.

src_l.t: Rose's Room / Altar of the Chosen / Tickington (GamerGuides)

tick.how: In Lonalulu, make your way to the church at the northern end of the main area. South of the church's entrance, near a tree, should be a white/light blue Tockle that hands over the pastword.

src_l.t: Chateau Felix / Altar of the Cursed King / Tickington (GamerGuides)

tick.how: Unlike the majority of the areas in Tickington, this one isn't unlocked by finding a Tockle in the world. Instead, you simply need to finish Chateau Felix in order to have access to it.

src_l.t: Chateau Felix / Dusk / Altar of the Cursed King / Tickington (GamerGuides)

tick.how: This Tockle is located in the final part of the game and requires you to do the side story in Cobblestone. You will need to find certain NPCs around the world and send them back to Cobblestone. Once you do this, return to Cobblestone to see it as normal and located Dunstan's house just north of the church. You will find the Tockle on the bed in the one room.

src_l.t: Trodain Castle / Altar of the Cursed King / Tickington (GamerGuides)

tick.how: Once you have full exploration of the Dundrasil Region, find the campsite there. South of that campsite will be a ruined building and inside that building will be the Tockle with the Pastword.

src_l.t: Rainbow Mines / Altar of the Forgotten Past / Tickington (GamerGuides)

tick.how: When you revisit Arboria during the middle portion of the game, there will be some story events and you will go to a place called Luminary's Landing. While you make the short trek to the top of this area, you should see a Tockle on the side that grants you the pastword to this area.

src_l.t: Roamer Encampment / Altar of the Forgotten Past / Tickington (GamerGuides)

tick.how: This area is another that doesn't have a pastword/Tockle attached to it, as you need to finish another area in order to unlock it. Simply finish Roamer Encampment and you will automatically receive the unlock from Rom Baro upon getting your reward.

src_l.t: Roamer Encampment / Night / Altar of the Forgotten Past / Tickington (GamerGuides)

tick.how: In Octagonia, in the middle portion of the game, you will be able to visit the casino on the upper floor. Near the slot machines that's right by the one desk (the machines are green), you will find a yellow Tockle that will give you this pastword.

src_l.t: Briscoletti's Mansion / Altar of the Heavenly Bride / Tickington (GamerGuides)

tick.how: The Tockle for this one is located at the L'Academie de Notre Maitre des Medailles. Head inside the main building and you should see the principal's office straight ahead. While facing the door to his office, go around to the left side to find the red Tockle.

src_l.t: The Neverglade / Altar of the Heavenly Bride / Tickington (GamerGuides)

tick.how: In the final act of the game, once you have the Ultimate Key from Havens Above, you can open all of those locked doors across Erdrea. Go to Cryptic Crypt, in the Hotto Region, and head all the way to the end of the dungeon. There will be four cells you can open with the Ultimate Key and the Tockle with the pastword is inside the eastern cell.

src_l.t: Whealbrook / Altar of the Heavenly Bride / Tickington (GamerGuides)

tick.how: Once you start doing the story bit in Hotto in the middle portion of the game, you will be asked to go to Mt. Huji. After the little event there upon first visiting, you will gain access to a secret hideout. On the one chair there in the secret hideout will be a red Tockle, who gives you the pastword.

src_l.t: Cannock Castle / Altar of the Legendary Line / Tickington (GamerGuides)

tick.how: The Tockle for this area is located in the Luminary's Trial - Citadel of Spite. It is found near the beginning, on the second floor, at the top of the stairs leading down to the first floor. You will need to go this way as you progress in the dungeon, so it's very hard to miss the Tockle, as it's out in the open.

src_l.t: Cave Leading to Rendarak / Altar of the Legendary Line / Tickington (GamerGuides)

tick.how: You will find the pastword for this one in the Gallopolis Region, by the southern campfire. There will be a red tockle there, so simply speak to it to get the pastword needed to unlock this.

src_l.t: Moonahan / Altar of the Legendary Line / Tickington (GamerGuides)

tick.how: Once you have access to the skies, with Cetacea, you can visit a variety of Whale Way stations, which are shown on the world map with golden sparkles. Head to the Zwaardsrust Whale Way Station and land there. Near the start, after passing through a little archway, you should see a blue Tockle, so speak with it to get the pastword.

src_l.t: Quester's Rest / Altar of the Starry Skies / Tickington (GamerGuides)

tick.how: This one is found on Insula Algarum, which is the island northeast of The Strand, and southeast of Sniflheim. Once you are there, in the middle portion of the game, head to the second area and get the mountable Dragon Rider mount. Fly around to the southern side of the island and look for the spot where you can land. This is the same spot that has the tree harvesting point. Once you're there, travel to the end of the narrow path to find a black/dark Tockle that gives you this pastword.

src_l.t: Ruby Path of Doom / Altar of the Starry Skies / Tickington (GamerGuides)

tick.how: You will find this Tockle in Laguna di Gondolia. There is a small cave you pass through to reach the central portion of the Laguna. That is where you will find the Tockle.

src_l.t: The Observatory / Altar of the Starry Skies / Tickington (GamerGuides)

tick.how: After saving Sniflheim from its icy doom, you will be able to fully explore the town. Head into the castle and go to the left to find a bedroom. Inside, you will see the purple Tockle in front of the mirror, who will give you the pastword for this area.

src_l.t: Room of Revival / Altar of the Undeciphered / Tickington (GamerGuides)

tick.how: Once you have the Ultimate Key from Havens Above in the final part of the game, head to Gondolia (might need to clear the story event there) and pass through the locked door. Near the one chest that contains 50000G, there is a small bench and the Tockle will be sitting on that bench.

src_l.t: Tenton / Altar of the Undeciphered / Tickington (GamerGuides)

tick.how: A later level of the Hall of Remembrance (see Level 1 for how the Hall opens).

src_l.t: Deepest Recesses of the Past / Hall of Remembrance / Tickington (GamerGuides)

tick.how: The Hall of Remembrance is a special area that opens up upon completing all other areas at the ten altars in Tickington.

src_l.t: Hall of Remembrance Level 1 / Hall of Remembrance / Tickington (GamerGuides)

tick.how: A later level of the Hall of Remembrance (see Level 1 for how the Hall opens).

drac.name: No Fleeing from Battle
drac.effect: The party cannot run away from fights.

drac.name: No Shopping
drac.effect: Items and equipment cannot be purchased from shops.

drac.name: Reduced Experience from Easy Fights
drac.effect: Enemies that are way weaker than the party give little to no experience (though they still drop items).

drac.name: All Enemies Are Super Strong
drac.effect: All enemies are way stronger than normal.

drac.name: Shypox
drac.effect: The Hero will sometimes do things out of the player's control, such as recalling an embarrassing memory that makes them lose their turn or not being able to talk to NPCs.

drac.name: Super Shypox
drac.effect: All the other party members will sometimes become afflicted by Shypox.

drac.name: Townsfolk Talk Tripe
drac.effect: NPCs will sometimes tell complete lies and non-sequiturs, though none of the lies are relevant or affect actual gameplay.

drac.name: Party Wiped Out if Protagonist Perishes
drac.effect: If the Hero falls in the battle, the party instantly loses the battle, and the player is sent back to the title screen.

steps.h: Choose your weapon: the Cobblestone Greatsword for more damage or the Cobblestone Sword if you want a shield.
Talk to Dunstan, the Elder, at the bridge.
Beat the Slime group up the path with plain attacks; Sandy helps and cannot fall.
Search behind the monument on the left for a Pot Lid.
Equip the Pot Lid only if you kept the sword.
Turn right at the first cave fork.
Climb the wall.
Take the Medicinal Herb by the tree.
Start every fight by swinging at the monster on the field so it takes damage before the battle.
Turn right at the fork past the bridge.
Smash the pots by the stairs for a Medicinal Herb and 5G.
Pick up the Copper Ore from the sparkly spot deeper in the caverns.
Fight the pair of Smogs.
Keep HP above 10.
Let Gemma heal you.
Use Frizz if your hits keep missing.
Grab the Pink Pine by the tree in the northwest corner.
Climb the rope.
After the Gryphon scene at the summit, take the second Pink Pine by the northwest tree.
Enter the cave.

get_h: Pot Lid - chest behind the monument at the base

source.t: Birth of a Luminary / Prologue / Walkthrough (GamerGuides)

steps.h: Go to your house in the northeast.
Talk to Amber to receive the Precious Pendant.
Leave the house at night.
Meet Gemma by the large tree near the entrance.
Search your home: the cupboard has Plain Clothes and the upstairs pots hold 10G.
Climb the crates onto the shed roof next door for a 50G chest and a Flurry Feather.
Talk to the quest villager below your house to start The People's Friend.
Hand over the Flurry Feather for a Sleeping Hibiscus.
Check every bookshelf you pass from now on; red books can be recipe books.
Buy a Bandana and Wayfarer's Clothes at the Item Shop.
Skip the Cypress Stick.
Smash the barrels in the southeast cave for a Seed of Agility, a Copper Ore and 7G.
Open the chest behind Gemma's house for a Cypress Stick.
Climb Gemma's roof for a Medicinal Herb.
Take the Fresh Water at the top of the waterfall by your house.
Go to the north entrance.
Talk to Dunstan for the Map of Erdrea, a horse and Gemma's Charm.

get_h: Seed of Agility - barrel in the southeast cave
50G and Flurry Feather - shed roof next to your house
