Open the cabin chest northwest of the city for a mini medal.
Ride a Face Invader in the Snaerfelt.
Ram the ice blocks by holding R2.
Cross the western archway for a mini medal chest.
Take Supercool Kit from behind the cabin by the Hekswood.
In the Hekswood, follow the western ice path south to Platinum Protection.
Fight Jörmun (820 HP) solo.
Keep HP above 100.
Use Unbridled Blade after its jig drops its defence.
Hit switches in the Royal Library to move shelves.
Take both recipe books from the Level 3 shelves.
Kill the Mimic (around 720 HP) on Level 4 quickly with Sap, Unbridled Blade and Multithrust before it uses Thwack.
Fight Krystalinda (1800 HP).
Raise Magic Barrier.
Cast Sap on her.
Cast Oomph on the Luminary and Jade.
Keep Hustle Dance going.
Take the Nobleman's Knife for Erik and the basement mini medal in the castle.
Get the Blue Orb.
Accept The Viking Hoard.
Accept A Cold Crush.
Read the Inn bookshelf for Platinum Power.
Pick the gold Snaerose south of the Snaerfelt camp for That's Magic.
Bring the Viking's gift from Insula Borealis.

get_h: Mini medal - cabin chest northwest of the city
Mini medal - Snaerfelt chest across the archway
Mini medal - Sniflheim Castle basement pot
Supercool Kit - behind the cabin near the Hekswood
Favourite Fashions of the Masters of Magic - Royal Library Level 3
An Anthology of Elemental Earrings - Royal Library Level 3

source.t: The Blue Orb / Act I / Walkthrough (GamerGuides)

steps.h: Ride a Runny Eggsoskeleton up the Pit Cave to the chest with a mini medal.
Loot Arboria: the mini medal chest by the entrance stairs, the Supplicant upstairs in the twins' house and the Item shop Sainted Soma.
Accept Fit as a Fiddle from the old man and Planting Seeds for the Future in the Grove of Repose.
Zoom to the Academie.
Trade medals for the Agility Gilet and Glombolero.
Shoot the Manglegrove targets.
Report to the camp bowyer.
See Bo in Gallopolis for the Happy Hat.
Open the chest north of the first fork in the Arborian Highlands for a mini medal.
Forge a Platinum Lance for Jade at the camp.
Rework any pieces you are equipping that are not at +3.
Open the cave chest in the First Forest for How to Outdo the Undead.
Pick the gold sparkly spot under the large northern tree for the Red Kale.
Fight Sprite Bulbs near the top until a Wight Bulb appears and drops the seeds.
Zoom to Arboria.
Turn in both quests for a Healer and a Butterfly Baton.
Use the well at the World Tree to return to the great altar.
Open the chest behind the altar for a mini medal.
Pick up the Yggdrasil Dew.
Keep the Yggdrasil Dew for emergencies.
Against Jasper at the Heart of Yggdrasil, use only buffs and healing; the fight cannot be won.

get_h: Mini medal - Pit Cave chest
Mini medal - Arboria, chest south of the entrance stairs
Mini medal - Arborian Highlands, north chest
Mini medal - First Forest, behind the great altar
How to Outdo the Undead - First Forest cave chest
Happy Hat - Bo, for every crossbow target

source.t: Onward to Yggdrasil / Act I / Walkthrough (GamerGuides)

steps.h: Note that only the items Sylvando carried are usable.
Skip the shops, since your forged gear beats their stock.
Talk to the man standing by the water at the stage in the north of Gondolia.
Talk to the Beastly Boys at the stall just left of the town entrance.
Beat the Beastly Boys, hitting the left one first because he raises their attack.
Return the knapsack to the man by the water.
Leave for the Gallopolis Region, ignoring the way to Grotta della Fonte.
In the Laguna di Gondolia cave, talk to the cow beside it.
Bring the milk to the tired priest so he joins.
Go to the peninsula south of Gallopolis.
Fight the Vicious Fandangow group there for the knight.
Lean on the priest's Midheal if their dance costs turns.
If the Cactolotl surfaces on that peninsula, walk away; it is far stronger than your group.
In Gallopolis, talk to the juggler in the southeastern tavern.
Pick the red ball.
Talk to the drummer outside the church.
Cheer up Margarita at the stables north of him.
Keep the horse poo she gives you.
Talk to the man outside the circus tent.
Watch the show.
Save.
Head out to the Hotto Steppe.
Give the horse poo to the man with the plant monster north of the Slime so he joins.
Rest at the camp past the north bridge.
Save at the camp.
Fight the Gigantes guarding the bridge to the east.
Put the Gigantes to sleep with the priest's sermon.
Heal with Hustle Dance after Crackerwhack, which hits everyone for around 80.
Enter Hotto to end the interlude; if you missed a recruit, the best outfit can still be earned later.

source.t: In Search of Hope / Character Interludes / Walkthrough (GamerGuides)

steps.h: Skip the Vicious Great Sabrecat packs outside Octagonia; you can fill their entries later.
Save at the Goddess statue.
Climb to the third level to meet Booga.
If lost, use the path beside the monster with the pink bubble.
In the Limboo cells, smash the southeastern cell pots for a Rockbomb Shard.
Smash the north-central cell pots for a Special Medicine.
Save with the big guy in the northeastern cell.
Enter the southwestern cell to continue.
Put the prisoner's free items into Jade's inventory.
Talk to the knight guarding the exit to start the gauntlet.
In the first fight, use Party Pooper on all three attackers; the Hare-Raising Suit revives you, but winning gives experience.
In the second fight, kill the Boodiful Wizards first, since their Frizzle deals 60 or more.
In the third fight, wipe out one pair quickly so they cannot pep up for Just Claws.
Against Boodica, use Multithrust on her two hands (about 350 HP each) before anything else.
Then wear Boodica down (about 1600 HP) while Sinderella heals with Midheal and powers you up with Oomph.

get_h: Special Medicine x3, Magic Water, Rockbomb Shard - from a prisoner on the walk to the gauntlet

source.t: Jade Journeys Forth / Character Interludes / Walkthrough (GamerGuides)

steps.h: Leave the cell.
Take the southeast exit.
Open the chest for a Steel Broadsword.
Crawl through the gap.
Listen at the wall crack to learn the key sits in the middle chest.
At the five-chest dead end, beat the Cannibox chests in the northwest and southeast for a Seed of Skill each.
Open the middle chest for the Hideout Key, plus the southwest and northeast chests for gear.
Unlock the north door in the first room.
Keep north, following the upper ledge to the crawl hole into the Ancient Ruins.
Ride the ornate platform across the chasm.
Save at the statue, which also refills HP and MP.
Clear the three monster groups at the dead lift.
Watch for Bobonga fire breath (around 70) and Professaurus Frizzle there.
Ride the powered lift.
Open the ledge chests for a Seed of Deftness and an Agility Ring.
In the Great Hall, climb the western wooden platform for the Disturbin' Turban chest.
Exit north.
Defeat the Vicious Chihuawyrm first.
Defeat the Skelegon next.
Defeat the Dragon Rider last.
Fight Indignus; your boosted regeneration makes losing unlikely, so pair Divide with ailment skills for big damage.

get_h: Seed of Skill x2 - Canniboxes in the five-chest room
Agility Ring - ledge chest past the big lift

source.t: Erik's New Acquaintance / Character Interludes / Walkthrough (GamerGuides)

steps.h: Chase the bunny girl.
Talk to the bunny girl to move to old Dundrasil.
Go to the throne room.
Sit on the left throne.
Answer yes when asked.
Search the cabinets in the room north of the throne room for a Sage's Elixir.
Talk to Irwin outside the throne room.
Sit on the throne.
Answer the audiences however you like.
Answer the trivia man by the saving priest with True, False, True, False, True for a Seed of Magic.
Take the western garden guard's posy to any red-haired person in green for a Pretty Betsy.
Bring the well-dressed man in the east middle-floor room any pungent item (the pie or a plant) for a Seed of Strength.
Talk to Irwin in the middle-floor garden.
Check the throne-room cupboards for a Dieamend.
Follow the bunny girl to the southern stairs.
Smash the corner pots in the room below for Wakerobins.
Talk to the young Luminary at each stop.
Answer the bunny girl yes twice.
Go up through the door.
Fight Grand Master Pang (losing still lets the story continue).
Put her to sleep with Snooze.
Attack with Zammle.
Heal with Moreheal.
Kill her Tantamount (about 320 HP) fast.
Defend after her second charge to soften the 11-hit attack.

get_h: Seed of Magic - trivia man near the saving priest
Seed of Strength - pepper errand, east middle-floor room
Pretty Betsy - posy errand

source.t: Lord Robert and the Kingdom of Dreams / Character Interludes / Walkthrough (GamerGuides)

steps.h: Swim around Nautica before seeing the Queen; chests hold a Seed of Skill, Elfin Elixir, Zombiesbane and a mini medal north of the item shop.
Talk to Queen Marina in the Palace.
Touch the pearl.
Grab the juicy prawn in the centre of town.
On the Emerald Coast, rest at the camp to re-register Zoom.
Go through Cobblestone Falls.
In The Last Bastion, climb the ladder at the far west past the weapon shop for a 3000G chest.
Meet the King in the Royal Tent.
Join Hendrik at the north barricade.
Against the Headless Honcho, kill the Vicious Grim Gryphon first.
Clear the escorts with Boom and Kasnooze.
Then hit the Honcho (about 690 HP) with Unbridled Blade, keeping HP above 150.
Take the Sewer Key from the King.
Climb the northwest vine in the Heliodorian Foothills to the secret sewer entrance.
If you want revenge on the Black Dragon, take the north path in the sewers.
Beat the Black Dragon (about 1050 HP) with Unbridled Blade.
In Heliodor Castle, search Jasper's Quarters for a Platinum Sword and The Devil's in the Details.
Move the southern shelves in the storage room past the kitchen to reach the bedchambers and their recipe books.
Fight Tyriant.
Kill each Shadow (about 280 HP) with Unbridled Blade.
Use magic during Sword Stance.
Keep HP above 150.
Zoom to The Last Bastion.
Go down the western stairs in the Cobblestone Tor caverns for Footwear of the Rich and Famous.
Talk to the King for the Shield of Heliodor.
Save at the church.
Set out for the Manglegrove.

get_h: The Devil's in the Details - Jasper's Quarters bookshelf, Heliodor Castle
A Recipe Book of Regal Regalia - King's Bedchamber bookshelf
Little Lifesavers - Queen's Bedchamber chest
Footwear of the Rich and Famous - Cobblestone Tor caverns, end of western stairs
Platinum Sword - Jasper's Quarters chest
Shield of Heliodor - from the King after Heliodor is freed

source.t: Dawn of a New World / Act II / Walkthrough (GamerGuides)

steps.h: In the Manglegrove, take the vine down to the southwest.
Open the chest to the north for a mini medal.
At the Manglegrove camp, forge a King Axe for Hendrik (or upgrade his axe) and Magic Armour at +3.
Rework the Shield of Heliodor to +3.
Forge a Shield-Bearer.
Equip the Shield-Bearer on Hendrik.
Cross to the Costa Valor.
Head north into Mount Pang Lai, ignoring the landslide.
In the Base Cave, beat a glittering Dragon Rider.
Fly the Dragon Rider across the water to the Mythril Ore spots.
On the Slopes, open the chest past the bridge for More Dragony Designs.
Open the chest east of town for a Staff of Antimagic.
In Angri-La, buy Dragon Hides and Dragon Horns at the item shop.
If you lacked materials for the King Axe, buy an Ice Axe.
Meet the High Lama in the High Hall.
Follow the High Lama east to the Field of Discipline.
Next morning, accept Understanding Angri-La near the priest.
Finish a Boreal Serpent with Blaze of Glory for a Mystic.
In the Summit Tunnel, fly a Dragon Rider to the northwest lake island for a Sorcerer's Ring.
At the summit camp, forge the Wyrmfang for the Luminary.
Rework the Ice Axe if you bought one.
Rest at the camp.
Save.
Spar with Rab by casting Quadraslash every turn; the aim is to power it up, not to beat him.
Defend the turn after Rab prepares himself to soften Pearly Gates.
Use Moreheal if HP drops below 150.
Leave the Wheel of Harma at the Field of Discipline alone until your party is around level 50.

get_h: More Dragony Designs - Mount Pang Lai Slopes, chest past the bridge
Staff of Antimagic - Mount Pang Lai Slopes, east of town
Sorcerer's Ring - Summit Tunnel lake island
Mystic - Understanding Angri-La reward
Ethereal Stone - Angri-La inn chest

source.t: Journey to Angri-La / Act II / Walkthrough (GamerGuides)

steps.h: Zoom to the Mount Pang Lai campsite.
Return to the Costa Valor.
Take the new passage west into the Champs Sauvage.
Mount a glittering Honeyhead Horknight near L'Academie.
Fly over the lake to a chest with a Sunny Citrine.
Accept Madame Labouche's Life Lesson from the Lips outside L'Academie; it needs 330 Charm.
Inside, accept A Delayed Diploma.
Accept A Fragrant Fille.
At night in the northeast classroom, accept One Last Request.
Trade your mini medals with the Headmaster for Spiked Armour and the Miracle Sword.
Accept A Right Riddle in the Bibliotheque.
Equip a Steel Broadsword, forging one if needed, to pass the first riddle.
Cross the large bridge south toward Phnom Nonh and escort Da home with the troupe.
In Phnom Nonh, accept Worth Its Salt.
Rest at the inn.
Register the nearby camp.
Swap the Mardi Garb for real armour to raise defence.
Go south to the Promontory Cave.
Fight Avarith (about 2200 HP).
Have Rab cast Antimagic to stop Kasizz.
Heal with Staff of Salvation and Right as Rain.
Lower her defence with Helm Splitter.
Hit with Unbridled Blade.
Cast Multiheal whenever your spells are unsealed.
Zoom back.
Meet Sylvando on the hill.
Take the Costa Valor east tunnel to Puerto Valor.
Before leaving Don Rodrigo's house, take Platinum Plating from the bookshelf.
Take a Finessence from the right wardrobe.
Accept When Knight Falls near the entrance.
Buy The Mothmask Prophecies at the casino, since it is a one-time prize.

get_h: Spiked Armour, Miracle Sword - mini medal rewards at L'Academie
Platinum Plating - Don Rodrigo's bookshelf, Puerto Valor
Finessence - Don Rodrigo's right wardrobe
The Mothmask Prophecies - Puerto Valor casino prize
Sunny Citrine - Champs Sauvage lake chest, needs a mount

source.t: Reuniting with Sylvando / Act II / Walkthrough (GamerGuides)

steps.h: Board the ship in the Costa Valor.
Sail northwest to the Zwaardsrust Region, leaving Gondolia for later.
Find the small gravestone in the hay fields southeast of the Warrior's Rest Inn.
Return to the girl from Quest 32 for a Chronocrystal.
Rework the Mardi Garb to +3 to hit 330 Charm.
Finish Madame Labouche's Life Lesson for Glam Gear for Go-Getters.
Register the Dundrasil Region camp.
Switch to night.
Ride a glittering Headless Horseman for the mount trophy.
Enter the castle ruins through the well.
Follow Rab's secret passage to the Sage's Elixir chest at the intersection.
Fight the Restless Knight (about 2400 HP).
Have Rab cast Blunt and Sap.
Have Rab lift curses.
Keep Blunt on the knight if he peps up.
Have Sylvando use Oomph on the Luminary.
Hit with Unbridled Blade for over 600 each.
In past Dundrasil, follow the King into the tunnels.
Use Quadraslash on the monster group.
Fight the Gloomnivore (about 2750 HP).
Use Blunt on its attack.
Paralyse it with Parallax.
Heal with Hustle Dance.
In Octagonia's casino, take the 2000 free tokens.
Spend your winnings on Love Potions, the only useful prize.
Load MP restoring items on Rab, the Luminary and Sylvando.
Give the Dracky by the stairs a Love Potion to enter the VIP area.
Fight Jinxed Jade (about 1800 HP).
Cast Sap on her.
Give the Luminary Oomphle for Unbridled Blade.
Keep HP high against Sexy Beam.
Fight Booga right after (about 3200 HP).
Use Sobering Slap on charmed allies.
Keep Blunt and Sap on him.
Use MP items freely.
If you want the Vest for Success, take Richie's Rock-Hard Roulette Challenge.
Bet on 12 and 14 once the jackpot bunny hints at a win.

get_h: Glam Gear for Go-Getters - Madame Labouche's Life Lesson reward
Chronocrystal - One Last Request reward
Lorelei's Harp - regained after Booga
Imp Knife - Octagonia casino prize, not found elsewhere
Vest for Success - Richie's Rock-Hard Roulette Challenge reward

source.t: Reuniting with Jade / Act II / Walkthrough (GamerGuides)

steps.h: Sail through the Valor-Sauvage Channel.
Stop at The Strand to register it for Zoom.
At Insula Algarum, ride a Dragon Rider to the hidden chests, including an Agate of Evolution on a small island.
In Lonalulu, accept Soothing Seaweed.
Accept My Kingdom for Some Kanaloamari.
Accept The Measure of a Man.
If My Kingdom for Some Kanaloamari or The Measure of a Man is missing, learn Flame Slash and Unbridled Blade.
Get the Dulcet Dulse from the merman on the Insula Algarum bridge.
Hand the Dulcet Dulse in at Lonalulu for Molten Globules.
Sail far north of Sniflheim to the Vortex of Light to trigger the Alizarin fight.
Against Alizarin (about 4800 HP), have Jade use Re-Vamp twice then Multithrust.
Have Hendrik use Kabuff and Helm Splitter in the same fight.
Stay fully healed during Crimson Mist and counter his slowdown; Sylvando heals with Hustle Dance or casts Oomphle on the Luminary.
In Sniflheim, see Queen Frysabel.
Visit the priest's back room.
Fight the golden monsters in town, focusing the Gyldenbritches.
Sail to the Viking Hideout.
Clear the Gyldennauts with Quadraslash.
Touch the Yggdrasil root to restore Erik.
Rebuild Erik with Cobra Strike, Victimiser, dual-wielding and Divide.
Open the chest east of the shelter for Snowfield Styles.
Enter the Gyldenhal.
In the Gyldenhal, take Gilt Gear on Level 2.
Avoid the slot machines that are Penny Pinchers in disguise.
Fight Gyldygga (about 3600 HP).
Use Blunt on her after she uses Oomphle.
Keep Hendrik as backup healer in case gold traps your main one.
Buy a Paladin's Lance for Jade.
Find the diploma student upstairs in the weapon shop.
Zoom back to L'Academie to complete the quest.

get_h: Agate of Evolution - Insula Algarum island chest, needs a mount
Snowfield Styles - Viking Hideout, east of the shelter
Gilt Gear - Gyldenhal Level 2 chest
Corsair's Cap - from beating Gyldygga
Gear that Glitters - A Delayed Diploma reward
Deft Dagger - mini medal reward at L'Academie

source.t: Reuniting with Erik / Act II / Walkthrough (GamerGuides)

steps.h: Take the Vortex of Light near Zwaardsrust to Nautica.
Accept Marking a Momentous Occasion in Nautica.
Accept Justice is Brined in Nautica.
Pep up the Luminary, Hendrik and Sylvando.
Use Arise on the Knight Aberrant in The Eerie Eyrie for a Metal Slime Shield.
On Insula Incognita, finish a Night Clubber with Buff-Buff once its name turns orange.
Claim a Venus' Tear in Lonalulu.
Collect the Kanono Cannon from the cannon lady in the house north of Lonalulu's item shop.
In the northern seas, finish a Tentacular with Tempered Tantrum for the Kanaloamari.
Trade the Kanaloamari in Lonalulu for a Pentarang.
Open the chest in the Insula Occidentalis cabin for the Sealicitor's Statutes.
In Nautica, give the turtle the Kanono Cannon.
Give the Courthouse mermaid the notes for Secrets of the Sunken Spirit and a Sovereign Seal.
Accept A Ballad of Bravery at the Warrior's Rest Inn.
Bring back Luter's Opus from the southwest Dundrasil hut.
In The Snaerfelt, accept A Dish Served Cold.
Fight Killing Machines at the Frozen Fjord until a Type G0 appears.
Equip any paralysis protection.
Rest at the camp.
Save at the camp.
Head past the Frozen Fjord toward Arboria.
Fight the Auroral Serpent (about 4900 HP).
Heal every round.
Cure paralysis with Sylvando's Tingle.
Deal damage with Sap, Oomphle-boosted Unbridled Blade, and Jade's double Re-Vamp into Multithrust; Hendrik casts Kabuff.
Give the reborn Serena Enchanting Echo first.
Give her Antimagic next to open Grace of the Goddess.
After getting the Calamus Flute, accept A Long-Lost Literary Love in Arboria.
Fly to each Whale Way Station for loot.

get_h: Secrets of the Sunken Spirit - Marking a Momentous Occasion reward
Fine Fashions for Philosophers - A Ballad of Bravery reward
Metal Slime Armour - A Dish Served Cold reward
An Album of Imperial Attire - Sniflheim Whale Way Station, southwest chest
An Earring for Every Element - Champs Sauvage Whale Way Station, north chest
Even More Dragony Designs - Hotto Steppe northern Whale Way Station, behind the locked door

source.t: Reuniting with the Twins / Act II / Walkthrough (GamerGuides)

steps.h: At Havens Above, take the Guiding Light in the Temple of Dawn.
Fly to The Battleground.
Use the Guiding Light on the object ahead.
Kill each Pandora's Box chest quickly with your strongest attacks before it casts Kathwack; each drops a Seed of Skill.
Mount a Dragooner in the central shaft to reach the caves that need flight.
At the camp near the bottom of the shaft, forge an Ogre Shield for Hendrik and Titan Belts for physical attackers.
Open the eastern B9 chest for Sacred Styles for Saintly Ladies.
On B6, fly to the western chest for Brace Yourself.
Follow the long north path to the Overlooked Cavern.
Take the Orichalcum.
In Gondolia, haggle between the brothers to buy Hendrik's Armour for 10000G.
Buy a Fizzle Foil.
At the Grotta della Fonte camp, forge the Goddess's Tiara and Saintess Dress for Serena, plus Mighty Armlets and Brainy Bracers.
Clear Worth Its Salt, A Right Riddle (equip the Fizzle Foil), The Search for the Sage's Stone and A Rose Arose Where No Rose Grows.
After the Celestial Sands event, talk to the Sultan in the Gallopolis throne room twice for the Forging Hammer.
At the Hotto Steppe camp, forge a Metal Gooreatsword for the Luminary.
When Tatsunaga attacks Hotto, have Hendrik cast Kabuff.
Attack with Unbridled Blade and Multithrust.
Watch for Tatsunaga's desperate attacks, which can top 200.
In Mount Huji, fight Tatsunaga (about 2400 HP).
Keep Kabuff up.
Use double Re-Vamp on Jade.
Cast Oomphle on the Luminary.
Get the Crucible Key from Miko's maid.
Unlock the far north door of Mount Huji.
Present the Guiding Light.

get_h: An Encyclopaedia of Expert Equipment - The Battleground B3, first north cave
Sacred Styles for Saintly Ladies - The Battleground B9, east chest
Brace Yourself - The Battleground B6, needs a Dragooner
Making the Most of Mythril - The Search for the Sage's Stone reward
Things to Do with Metal Goo - A Long-Lost Literary Love reward
Hendrik's Armour - Gondolia merchant, 10000G

source.t: Forging the Sword of Legend / Act II / Walkthrough (GamerGuides)

steps.h: Heal fully at an inn or camp.
Use the Calamus Flute to fly to the Fortress of Fear.
Fight Indignus (about 3500 HP).
Cast Sap on him.
Cure Gigathrow paralysis with Tingle at once.
Keep HP above half.
Since he strips buffs, keep up steady damage with Jade's Multithrust or Multifeet and an Oomphled Unbridled Blade rather than rebuffing.
Save at the Goddess Statue in the corner.
Beat the Dark Dullahans inside the door.
Open the Level 1 west chest for Pride of the Valkyries.
Forge Pride of the Valkyries at a camp for Jade.
Take General Directives from the Level 3 west chest.
Open the shortcut.
Forge Hendrik's gear.
On the Level 3 exterior, search behind the Jerkules for In Fine Fettle with Liquid Metal.
After breaking the central crystals, forge the Liquid Metal Gooreatsword, Liquid Metal Spear and Liquid Metal Armour for the Luminary.
Hit the Level 4 switches.
Open the north door on Level 1 for the Meteorite Bracer.
Give the Meteorite Bracer to your healer.
Save at the outside Goddess Statue.
Grab the Sage's Elixir chest past the raised platforms.
Cross the bridge.
Fight Jasper Unbound (about 3600 HP).
Have Hendrik cast Kabuff so Jasper wastes turns removing it.
Ignore Jasper's summons.
Attack Jasper with Sword Dance or Unbridled Blade plus Multifeet.
Keep one healer on duty with HP above half.
Stock MP items and Yggdrasil Leafs.
Fight Mordegon, Lord of Shadows (about 5500 HP).
Kill the Shadow of Shadows before it casts Kabuff.
Against Mordragon, kill Mordragon's tail first so it cannot revive him with Kazing.
Use Magic Barrier.
Swap tired party members in.

get_h: Pride of the Valkyries - Level 1 west chest, best Act II armour for Jade
General Directives - Level 3 west chest, best Act II gear for Hendrik
In Fine Fettle with Liquid Metal - Level 3 exterior, behind the Jerkules
Meteorite Bracer - Level 1, behind the locked north door
Liquid Metal Jacket - Level 1 west, under the stairs

source.t: The Fortress of Fear / Act II / Walkthrough (GamerGuides)

steps.h: Try to leave Arboria after the party scene.
Zoom to the Dundrasil camp when you are ready to push the story on.
Go through the northern pass toward Octagonia.
Go south to the Mysterious Ruins.
Take the Wheel of Time on their west side.
Fly Cetacea to the tower north of Yggdrasil.
Open the chest behind the tower to the northwest for Good Godly Gear.
Open the tower door with the Wheel of Time.
Collect A Hero's Book of Basic Weapons on the northern cog route to evolve your Poker, Stardust Sword or Bad axe.
Talk to every companion at the Altar of Ages.
Agree through Erik.
Shatter the Time Sphere.
Re-equip the party with the gear they wore at the end of Act II; their levels come back later in the story.
Walk straight through the First Forest to Yggdrasil without grinding, using the Orbs at the altar.
Against Jasper, spam Sword Dance with the Luminary (550+ per use against roughly 2055 HP) while Sylvando heals.
If Jasper cloaks himself with the Orb, hit him with the Luminary first to break it before the others attack.
In Heliodor Castle, grab the Seed of Defence from the kitchen side room.
Grab the Mighty armlet from Hendrik's quarters.
Save with the Priest.
Against Mordegon (2500 HP), ignore the staves unless you are using group attacks.
Use Boom with Veronica when the staves are out.
Have Sylvando or Veronica cast Oomph on the Luminary.
Attack with Sword Dance or Unbridled Blade.
If Purple Mist is active, stop all healing spells until it fades, because it turns healing and buffs against you.
Travel to the Emerald Coast.
Take the Calamus Flute.
Fly to the floating island in the northeast.
Speak to the Elder at the Place of Legends in Havens Above.
Open the nearby chest for the Ultimate key.
Take the Guiding Light at the Temple of Dawn to restore levels and Zoom points.
Plan skills toward Gigagash, Kaboomle, Grace of the Goddess and Clear Your Mind.
Accept Quest 48 Wisdom of the Warrior King on the southwest island and Quest 49 from the Watcher by the northeast Item shop.

get_h: Good Godly Gear - Lost Land, chest behind the Tower of Lost Time
A Hero's Book of Basic Weapons - Tower of Lost Time, before the last cog
Calamus Flute - from Veronica on the Emerald Coast
Ultimate key - Havens Above, Place of Legends chest

source.t: In Search of Lost Time / Act III / Post Game / Walkthrough (GamerGuides)

steps.h: Speak to Gemma at your home in Cobblestone to begin the rebuilding quest that runs through all of Act III.
Fight the Malicious Hades condor in Cobblestone Tor (about 4500 HP).
Have Hendrik cast Magic Barrier against its 200+ HP Kasizzle.
Heal with Sage's stone.
Attack the condor with Sword Dance and a Re-Vamped Jade using Multifeet.
Climb the Tor summit to accept Quest 50 Mister Vista.
Talk to the King of Heliodor for the Golden tiara.
Take Tome 1 of Quest 48 from Jasper's room.
Open the dungeon cells for King of the Swindlers.
Liberate Gondolia.
Open its Ultimate Key door for 50000G.
Haggle the merchant brothers down to 20000G for Jade's Divine bustier.
Ride a Malicious Dragooner around Insula Centralis for Orichalcum and three Agate of Evolution.
Finish Mister Vista in Cobblestone Tor for a Fantastick.
At the First Forest Whale Way Station, take Upper-Class Accessories and the Pepper tree branch.
Hand the branch to Faris to finish Perfectly Pepped Paladins for four Pep pips.
Trade Mini Medals at L'Academie for the Circle of serendipity.
Forge the Straight poker at a camp.
Rework the Metal king armour and Fantastick at a camp.
In the Kingsbarrow, Pep Up Sylvando and Hendrik on the way down.
Bench them.
Wear Tweedledoom (3000 HP, Seismic Shock) to orange HP first.
Swap Sylvando and Hendrik in to finish each Tweedle with Executioner; if Hendrik is no longer Pepped for the second one, throw him a Pep pip.
From here on, open every big fight with Hendrik casting Immense Defence.
Have Hendrik follow with Forbearance.
Let Sylvando hand turns to Jade with Ladies First.
Fight the Malicious Gloomnivore under Dundrasil (about 5200 HP).
Land Sap and Blunt on him.
Attack with Sword Dance and Multifeet.
Against the Malicious Merking at The Strand, focus the Merking.
Hit the Mermaniacs only with group attacks like Kaboomle, Gold Rush and Pink Tornado.
Bring Serena and Sylvando to the Merking fight.
Hunt a Harmachis at the Southern Hotto Steppe station with the Circle of serendipity to finish Might Is Right! for the Apollo's axe.
Fight Bathysfear (about 5600 HP).
Keep HP above 300.
Tank Ready Blade with Forbearance.
Land Sap before the Luminary starts attacking.
In the Caverns Under Octagonia, beat the MMA fighters with Kaboomle fed by Sylvando.
Face the Malicious Arachtagon (about 5600 HP) with a twice Re-Vamped Jade and Snap, Crackle, Poof.
Against the Malicious Grey gordon (about 5400 HP), kill Gordon first.
Clear Gordon's summons with Pink Tornado, Kaboomle and Gigagash or Quadraslash.
Against the Malicious Jörmun (about 2800 HP), land the killing blow with a Zap-family spell from the Luminary.
Bring Erik to the Jörmun fight for Cock-a-doodle-doo against Kasnooze.
Against the Malicious Arboreal Serpent (about 7600 HP), equip Paralysis protection.
Bring Sylvando to the Arboreal Serpent fight for Tingle, Oomphle and Ladies First.
Touch the last Seedlings at the Laguna di Gondolia and Zwaardsrust stations.
Take the Wheel of Time from the Elder.
Climb the Tower of Lost Time again.

get_h: Divine bustier - Gondolia merchant brothers, haggle to 20000G
Pirate king's coat - rebuilt Cobblestone shop, completes Erik's set
Glammer Gear for Goer-Getterers - L'Academie Mini Medal reward
The Way of the War Goddess - Battleground B9, after the Crystalotl
Harmonicrystal - from the Crystalotl, completes Quest 49
Gemma's eternal charm - Gemma, once Cobblestone is rebuilt

source.t: A Tour of Erdrea / Act III / Post Game / Walkthrough (GamerGuides)

steps.h: Stack dark resistance on Hendrik before starting, for example the Field marshal's finery (40% at +3) and the Ruinous shield (50% at +3).
Talk to the guard with the pink speech bubble in the main hall of Heliodor Castle.
Touch the Yggdrasil root in the courtyard.
Follow the shadow to the dining hall's side room.
Interact at the shelf.
Go to Jasper's old room.
Interact with the shadow.
Read the journal on the table.
Follow the shadow from the main hall past the throne room and upstairs to the balcony to trigger the duel.
Attack with your strongest single-target skill: Parallax with an axe, Unbridled Blade with a greatsword, or Gyrfalcon Slash with a sword.
Heal with Moreheal only when needed.
Against Jasper Unbound, skip buffs unless you need them, since his disruptive wave strips them.
Keep attacking in the third phase, when the darkness damages Jasper on its own and most of his attacks miss.

get_h: Twin eagle armour - reward for the duel, needed for the costume trophy

source.t: An Old Friend / Act III / Post Game / Walkthrough (GamerGuides)

steps.h: Go through the glyph door in the ruins west of the Warrior's Rest Inn.
Take the portal into the Realm Between Worlds.
In Drustan's Labyrinth, loot the Sacred armour behind the cabin and the Serpent's soul, using a Visor kaiser mount to break the ice.
At Trial Isle, forge new gear.
Zoom to Havens Above.
Accept Quest 60 Lost Lovers from the Watcher.
In the Cruel Crypt, drop through the southeast hole for Kings of the Rings.
Take Erdwin's bracelet from the slot machine room.
In the Eerie Valley, collect the Lumen essence, A Hero's Book of Better Weapons and Drustan's helm.
Put the helm on Hendrik.
Fight Blind hatred (4200 HP, 25 turns).
Tank with Hendrik's Immense Defence and Forbearance.
Kill each 900 HP Shadow fast.
Deal damage with Re-Vamped Multifeet boosted by Sylvando's Ladies First, or Erik's poison-boosted Divide attacks under Oomphle.
Pick the Super Powerful Weapon wish first to get Supreme Secrets of the Sword of Light.
Turn in Lost Lovers.
In Hotto, accept The Legendary Treasure of Legend at the Inn.
Sell Orichalcum to the man outside the western Item shop.
Collect the Hotto stuff past Mount Huji's Secret Entrance.
Give Miko the Lumen essence.
Buy the Sword of Kings.
Get the Crucible key.
Win the Easy Gold Cup at the Gallopolis Racetrack for the Forging hammer, aiming for a lap time of 22-23 seconds.
Trade two Serpent's souls to Krystalinda for Crimsonites.
Forge a Sword of Light at the Crucible.
Forge the Supreme Sword of Light on Trial Isle.
Dual-wield the Super Sword of Light and Supreme Sword of Light +3 on the Luminary if he knows Gigagash and Sword Dance.
Loot Serenica's circlet in the Fierce Forest.
Loot Drustan's shield and Eternal Elegance in Hoarder's Keep, using Peep to spot the Token Takers.
Fight Unfathomable anger (7500 HP, 30 turns).
Land Sap.
Tank with Hendrik.
Have a double Re-Vamped Jade use Multifeet for 1000+ damage.
Pick the wedding wish.
Rework Drustan's shield to +3.
Finish the L'Academie album for Erdwin's shield and Making Things with Metal Kings.
In the Citadel of Spite, take Drustan's Sword.
Switch Hendrik to sword and shield.
Open the red door for Drustan's armour, Erdwin's tunic and Serenica's surplice.
Fight Sheer Decadence (4800 HP) and All-consuming greed (about 2600 HP, 40 turns).
Open with Veronica's Magic Burst for 1500+.
Bench Veronica.
Keep Hendrik tanking and Serena on Omniheal.
Use Gigagash while both live.
Take the Ogler's digest wish.
Against Abject terror (7800 HP) and Darkest despair (4200 HP, 50 turns), drop both low before killing either so neither gets revived with Kazing.
Hit Abject terror with magic and Darkest despair with physical attacks.

get_h: Kings of the Rings - Cruel Crypt, lower level southeast
Supreme Secrets of the Sword of Light - first wish from Drustan
Eternal Elegance - Hoarder's Keep, Level 1 south
Drustan's Sword - Citadel of Spite, Level 3 exterior
Erdwin's Coronet - Citadel of Spite, Level 3 northwest
Ye Manifold Methods of Mighty Drustan - Citadel of Spite, under the Level 1 stairs

source.t: The Drustan Trials / Act III / Post Game / Walkthrough (GamerGuides)

steps.h: Learn Pep Up on the Luminary, Lightning Thrust on Jade and Critical Claim on Erik before you start levelling.
Near a camp, defend in a battle until Erik, Jade, Sylvando and Rab are Pepped.
End the battle with the Luminary using Pep Up.
Save.
Give Sylvando a Pep pip.
Start a battle with the Luminary, Erik, Jade and Sylvando.
Cast Haulellujah.
Swap Erik for Rab.
Re-Pep the Luminary.
Have Sylvando use a Pep pip on Jade.
Let the enemies act.
Cast Electro Light.
If no metal slimes appear, reload.
If metal slimes appear, sleep them with Dirge of Dundrasil.
Kill the sleeping metal slimes with Critical Claim and Lightning Thrust for 4-6 levels per run.
In Harma trials one to three, open with Sword Dance, Gigagash or Pink Tornado.
Finish groups with Kathwack, Pearly Gates or Magic Burst.
In the Fourth Trial, use Critical Claim on each Hardy hand and Gyrfalcon Slash on the Clangoustine.
Use Sword Dance on the Red giant solo.
In the Final Trial, kill every enemy in the same round to stop reinforcements.
Open with Hendrik's Gyrfalcon Slash on the Shadeshifter and Rab's Pearly Gates.
In the Final Trial's second battle, open with Channel Anger and Kaswooshle.
End the battle with Veronica's Magic Burst.
In the third battle, have Erik use Divide and Sylvando use That's Amore.
Use Critical Claim on the Pandora's big bad box while Sylvando uses Gold Rush.
Stay within 14 actions.
In the last battle, wear down the Infernal serpent (4000 HP) and Manticore (3600 HP).
Use Gigagash and Pink Tornado so all fall together.
Forge the Legate's blade +3.
Give the Legate's blade to the High Hall monk to finish Pointless Pride for Seeds of Skill.
Equip Hendrik with two Skull ring +3 for full dark immunity.
Forge gear to +3.
Give Elfin elixirs to Veronica and Serena.
Against Overweening pride (12000 HP, 50 turns), keep Hendrik on Immense Defence and Forbearance.
Have Serena use Omniheal and Divine Intervention on Hendrik.
Bring Erik with dual swords for Divide plus Fatal Flash.
Use the Luminary's Gigagash once reinforcements arrive.
Spend Pep Powers before Disruptive Wave removes them: Mighty Magic Burst for 4000+, or Yggdragon's Blessing.
Use Kerplunk if most of the party is down.
Keep the Super Sword of Light on the Luminary.
Stock MP items and Yggdrasil leafs.
Fly Cetacea toward the dark star.
On the Luminary's first turn against Calasmos, use the Super Sword of Light from the inventory to strip the dark aura.
Fight Calasmos with Hendrik tanking, Serena on Omniheal, and the Luminary and Veronica using Gigagash and Kaboomle on the Darklings.
Cast Magic Barrier against Projectile of Darkness (250+ to the party).
Spend your saved Pep pops and Elfin elixirs here.

get_h: Shine On, Xenlon - Wheel of Harma, Fourth Trial reward
A Hero's Book of Brilliant Weapons - for taking all five of Drustan's wishes
Skull ring - forge, or rare steal from Infanticores in Dundrasil

source.t: Echoes of an Elusive Age / Act III / Post Game / Walkthrough (GamerGuides)

steps.h: Unlock the Secret Trial by finishing all of Drustan's Trials and every other Wheel of Harma trial within its turn limit.
Equip two Catholicon rings each on the Luminary and Jade, and two Venus' tears each on Erik and Sylvando.
Give Erik two Hunter's moons.
Put Meteorite bracers on Serena and Hendrik so they act before Veronica.
Pep Up Veronica and Serena before entering the trial.
In round 1, have Serena start Mighty Magic Burst.
Have Hendrik throw an Elfin elixir to Veronica.
Have Veronica finish with Magic Burst.
If the turn order goes wrong or the Archbashop casts Bounce, flee or reload.
Retry round 1.
In round 2, cast Infinite Wisdom on Rab first.
Use Kacrackle every turn against Boodica without recasting the buff.
If Rab gets low, especially once the doppelganger appears, heal him with Fullheal or a Yggdrasil dew.
In round 3, have Erik use Divide while Sylvando casts Oomphle on him.
Use Double Down aimed at the Coralossus.
If the Coralossus uses Forbearance, have Sylvando use Gold Rush (about 300 each) while Erik keeps using Double Down.
In round 4, attack Grand Master Pang nonstop, healing only with the Luminary's Omniheal.
Use Re-Vamp once with Jade in her spellcasting stance.
Keep Multifeet and Sword Dance on Pang when she summons an Equinox and a Godsteed.
Brace on the turn after her second power-up.
Once Pang falls, clear the horses with Pink Tornado and Gigagash or Quadraslash.
Finish in under 50 moves for extra Super Seeds of Defence, since the reward cannot be earned again.

source.t: Wheel of Harma's Secret Trial / Definitive Edition Endgame / Walkthrough (GamerGuides)

steps.h: Unlock the fight by defeating the End of Time in the Deepest Recesses of the Past.
If fighting without the Pep Power trick, farm only Seed of defence, Seed of life and Seed of strength, aiming for 999 HP, 999 Attack and about 500 defence.
Buy a stack of Pep pops at the rebuilt Cobblestone shop, about 20 split across the party.
Buy Elfin elixirs at the Octagonia Casino; Magic Burst deals about three times Veronica's MP, and each of the two parts has 20,000 HP.
Bring the Luminary, Erik, Veronica and Rab.
Equip Catholicon rings against the sleep and confusion attacks.
Pep Up all four in a normal battle by defending, swapping each one out once Pepped to keep the state.
Fly Cetacea into the rift above the Tower of Lost Time.
Open the fight with Yggdragon's Blessing which makes your characters invulnerable to damage.
When the Blessing icon starts flashing, throw a Pep pop so you can cast it again; it only lasts 2-3 turns.
Hit the Timewyrm's tail first with Magic Burst, refilling Veronica with Elfin elixirs; expect Disruptive Wave at every phase switch.
When the main body casts its double-MP mist, keep using Magic Burst but expect half damage per cast.
In the final phase, if either part gets Pepped, strip it with Rab's Rake 'n' Break or Clear Your Mind to stop Malicious Magic Burst and Blackest Mark.
If fighting normally, reapply Kabuff, Magic Barrier and Insulatle each phase.
If fighting normally, bring the Luminary and Serena for Omniheal.
If fighting normally, attack with Sword Dance.
Use the Sands of Lost Time to refight it if you want the Accolades for winning in under 70 or under 50 turns.

get_h: Hare-raising suit - Timewyrm reward, auto-revives Jade, final costume
Sands of Lost Time - Timewyrm reward, lets you refight it

source.t: Timewyrm / Definitive Edition Endgame / Walkthrough (GamerGuides)
